ProfileResolution.description: The resolved issuer-and-recipient identity context produced by the Profile Resolver before the issuer and wallet transformation phases. Carries the DID identifiers and profile references needed by downstream delivery adapters.

issuer_id.description: DID of the credential issuer (the institution or platform issuing the badge). Used as the `issuer` field in the unsigned VC.

recipient_did.description: DID of the credential recipient (the learner's LearnCard wallet identity). Used as `credentialSubject.id` in the unsigned VC.

recipient_profile_id.description: LearnCard profile id of the recipient (the learner's LearnCloud network profile id). Used as the `profileId` path parameter when sending a credential to the LearnCloud wallet API.
